integrity: The k=1 complete-multipartite zero-forcing special case is explicitly treated as prior work; the retained contribution is the arbitrary-k all-set criterion, the resulting exact minimum formula, and the exact count of minimum k-forcing sets.
scientific_limitations: The theorem uses the standard undirected k-forcing rule and does not transfer automatically to connected, oriented, skew, positive-semidefinite, probabilistic, or game variants.
The exhaustive computational check is finite (order at most 9 and k at most 4); the infinite result rests on the proof.
An equivalent statement under poorly indexed older terminology remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: All k-forcing sets of complete multipartite graphs
